-hey-my-buddy/

-    ├── agents/openai.yaml      # Codex 技能接口元数据

-  echo "已存在同名技能，未做任何修改：$HOME/.codex/skills/deepseek-delegate" >&2

-node "$PWD/deepseek-delegate/scripts/run.mjs" \
